summary: The CLI count is passed to spmvCuda; CSR generation stores n=floor(dim²/sparsity) entries and sets the final row delimiter to n. The average selects exactly one of warp widths 2/4/8/16/32. Its host launch helper caps blocks at 65535, while the kernel’s group=row mapping advances by gridDim*blockDim/Width, so all rows are covered; each subgroup traverses all j in the CSR interval in Width strides and lane 0 stores the row. The warmup call is synchronized before the event start. Compiled main dispatches through the chosen width-specific helper; the timed loop increments one counter per helper invocation until it equals iterations, then records/synchronizes the stop event. Each of the five actual launchSpmv helpers reaches cudaLaunchKernel with the corresponding native kernel. Inspected each of the five selectable sm86 kernels through its full CSR multiply-accumulate loop/backedge, reduction, output store and exit. No omission identified.
